item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00249","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C25","C09","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C25","confidence":0.94,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C25 plausibly supplied a material drafting template because it contains the child's unusually specific statutory authority formula—section 91 of the April 30, 1900 act, as amended by section 7 of the May 27, 1910 act—embedded in the same sequence of Hawaii-land restoration recitals, an operative restoration clause, and a metes-and-bounds description. C09 is especially close factually because it concerns Hilo land set aside for aeronautical purposes, while C16 closely matches the streamlined single-parcel restoration structure, but neither displayed text reproduces the child's distinctive authority clause.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"by virtue of the authority in me vested by section 91 of the act of April 30, 1900, 31 Stat. 141, 159, as amended by section 7 of the act of May 27, 1910, 36 Stat. 443, 447, it is ordered","parent_excerpt":"by virtue of the authority vested in men by section 91 of the act of April 30, 1900, 31 Stat. 159, as amended by section 7 of the act of May 27, 1910, 36 Stat. 447, it is ordered as follows","explanation":"This nearly verbatim and unusually specific statutory invocation is concrete evidence of reusable drafting language, not merely generic restoration boilerplate."},{"child_excerpt":"it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that such land be restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii","parent_excerpt":"such lands are no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii","explanation":"Both use the same predicate-and-restoration recital immediately before the authority and operative provisions."},{"child_excerpt":"all of the land previously set aside ... be, and it is hereby, restored to the possession, use, and control of the Government of the Territory of Hawaii","parent_excerpt":"The following-described tract of land ... and the rights-of-way thereto ... are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii","explanation":"The operative machinery is the same: identify previously reserved Hawaiian land, restore it to territorial control, and follow with a detailed survey description."}]}
